body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Dubrovnik, Croatia. The listing gives its length as 1 – 1 hours 20 minutes, over a route of about 1 км. It starts at Pile Gate, Dubrovnik, Ulica Vrata od Pila. There is no live guide: the tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Dive into the past and present of the city of Dubrovnik guided by your own in-app audio tour.
>
> Explore the beautiful Pile Gate with the statue of St. Blaise - the patron-saint of Dubrovnik above. The gate, together with the other fortifications of Dubrovnik, are included in the UNESCO World Heritage List.
>
> Wander at the wonderful Milicevic Square where the symbol of Dubrovnik is located — the Onofrio's Fountain. The fountain is especially lovely in the evening thanks to the built-in illumination.
>
> Admire the magnificent St. Savior Church - one of the few buildings in Dubrovnik, which withstand the disastrous earthquake occurred in the 17th century.
>
> Walk through the Luza Square with the Orlando's Column. With a figure of a knight Orlando - the hero of the epic poem "The Song of Roland", it is the monument to freedom.
>
> Discover the famous Old City Harbor with its breathtaking views of the city and sea. Have a look at the St. John’s Fortress, one of the most impressive monumental buildings of Dubrovnik.
>
> Gaze at the Dominican monastery built in the 13th century. It combines 3 architectural styles: Gothic, Baroque and Renaissance.
>
> Climb at the Revelin Fortress which made the defensive system of Dubrovnik impregnable. Today it is used for concerts and exhibitions.
